Star Wars Actor Hayden Christensen Recounts Bizarre Home Burglary Involving a Fan

03 Nov 2026, 12:27 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysActor Hayden Christensen, known for playing Anakin Skywalker in the Star Wars franchise, recently shared a strange real-life encounter involving a home burglar who turned out to be a fan.

Actor Hayden Christensen, known for playing Anakin Skywalker in the Star Wars franchise, recently shared a strange real-life encounter involving a home burglar who turned out to be a fan.

A Surprising Discovery at Home

Speaking at L.A. Comic Con and reported by media outlets, Christensen recalled an incident from years ago when his house was broken into. While upstairs, the actor heard the door open and initially mistook the intruder for a delivery worker before realizing the person was holding his personal belongings.

According to Christensen's account:

  • The intruder recognized the actor mid-robbery.
  • The burglar reportedly apologized and returned the stolen items.
  • Christensen learned that the man was struggling financially and trying to find a way home.

Unusual Resolution and Ongoing Career

Rather than escalating the situation, Christensen offered unexpected assistance. He reportedly gave the man clothes and shoes to help with job interviews and offered to help him get to the train station, though the individual ultimately did not show up the following day.

Beyond this past event, Christensen continues his long-running association with the Star Wars universe. Having first appeared as Anakin Skywalker in 2002's *Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones*, he has since returned for prequel-era projects, Disney+ streaming series like *Obi-Wan Kenobi* and *Ahsoka*, and is anticipated to appear in the upcoming second season of *Ahsoka*.
